Backup.Title: Backup and restore
Backup.Hint: Save your configuration to a file to get it back after a reinstall or on another PC.
Backup.Included:
• Profiles, avatars and profile passwords
• IPTV sources and TMDB key
• Parental PIN and locked categories
• All settings and preferences
• History, resume points and My List
• Favourite channels
• Recordings list (scheduled and finished)
Backup.Excluded:
• Recorded video files (they stay in their folder)
• TV guide, posters, catalogues and TMDB details: they reload automatically
• Logs
Backup.SecretsHint: Source passwords and the TMDB key are encrypted for this Windows account. To restore them on another PC (or after reinstalling Windows), protect the backup with a password. Without a password, they can only be restored on this PC and account.
